adversarial_qualification.qualification_root_recorded_at: each stage that runs the suite it depends on

baselines_and_ablations.A1_recoverability_removed: the identical selector with the recoverability score replaced by a constant, isolating the selector machinery from the estimate
baselines_and_ablations.A2_topology_blinded: the predictor evaluated with candidate_topology_id held fixed, testing whether q(o_i, tau) is really q(o_i); maps to the TOPOLOGY_CONDITIONING_WEAKNESS falsification condition
baselines_and_ablations.A3_capacity_matched_non_message_passing: a non-message-passing predictor matched as closely as practical to M2 on parameter count and input processing, trained on TRAIN-R under the identical frozen recipe. This is the ONLY admissible basis for a message-passing causality claim and must be frozen at CR-8 before MECH-R exists.
baselines_and_ablations.B0_fixed_topology: fixed COMPACT and fixed LINE, no adaptation
baselines_and_ablations.B1_reactive_adaptation: topology adaptation from instantaneous geometry and safety only, with no recoverability estimate
baselines_and_ablations.R1_full_rvt: the frozen winning family at the downstream representative seed, recoverability-aware counterfactual topology adaptation

calibration_contract.elevation_requires: an explicit hypothesis frozen before the relevant data exists
calibration_contract.fixes: the pilot wrapper that caught CalibrationContractError as a bare type across all families and wrote a hard-coded, unverified explanation into a sealed record
calibration_contract.rule: if the number of distinct logits < 2 then calibration_identifiable = false, intercept = null, slope = null

central_thesis.predictor_role: an enabling component, not the claim
central_thesis.statement: RVT-Swarm is a decentralized swarm-control method in which each robot uses only locally available sensing and neighbor messages to estimate probabilistic future recoverability under candidate local interaction topologies, evaluates those topologies counterfactually, and adapts its local interaction topology to improve swarm recovery, task progress and liveness while preserving obstacle avoidance and safety.

closed_loop_architecture.centralized_computation_allowed_only_for: offline training and explicitly declared development diagnostics
closed_loop_architecture.known_integration_gap: select_topology_from_score_signal currently thresholds a score at >= 0.0 and carries no dwell or hysteresis parameter. Mapping a probability q in (0,1) onto that score, and any dwell or hysteresis, are integration decisions that must be developed on CL-DEV-R inside the declared design space and frozen at CR-8.

development_budget.ledger: an append-only hash-chained CL-DEV-R ledger; every evaluated configuration is recorded with its parameters and its development endpoints before the next is run
development_budget.stopping_procedure: stop at 40 configurations, or after 3 consecutive configurations fail to improve the primary development endpoint, whichever comes first

may_not_change: the predictor inputs (the frozen input contract)
tunable_on_CL_DEV_R: the probability-to-score mapping and its topology-selection threshold
recoverability aggregation across robots and candidates

closed_loop_hypotheses.H-CL1: recoverability-aware decentralized topology adaptation improves recovery, task progress and liveness relative to the frozen no-recoverability reactive comparator
closed_loop_hypotheses.H-CL2: the improvement is achieved without unacceptable degradation in obstacle avoidance and safety
closed_loop_hypotheses.H-CL3: removing or blinding the recoverability-topology mechanism reduces the benefit, supporting the proposed mechanism

allowed: controller and selector tuning inside the frozen design space

MECH-R.generated_only_after: the mechanism contract is frozen at CR-8

PROTECTED-R.opened_only_after: the clean novelty checkpoint, under the frozen protected protocol

TRAIN-R.internal_use_allowed: internal folds for the frozen early-stopping and refit-step rules; this is training, not selection
TRAIN-R.purpose: train the final clean-room predictive models from scratch

layout_offset_assignment.declared_limitation: all six roles draw from the same ten layout families f1-f10 at different generator offsets. They are disjoint by identity, but they are not independent worlds: conclusions are conditional on the f1-f10 layout family population. PROTECTED-R additionally sits in the separate final-test namespace.
layout_offset_assignment.forbidden_reason: offsets within approximately 0.03 of, or crossing, the final-test base offset 0.79

disjointness_contract.overlap_test: for each ordered pair of roles and each identity field, the intersection of the manifest-enumerated identity sets must be empty; the check is deterministic, runs on enumerated IDs only, and fails closed

downstream_representative.role: the predefined runtime representative AFTER family selection only
downstream_representative.rule: downstream representative seed = 47 for whichever learned family wins

episode_universe_contract.driver_must_assert_before_statistics: observed source episode IDs are a subset of manifest source episode IDs, the manifest count matches its own enumeration, and every declared episode carries layout membership
episode_universe_contract.fixes: the pilot Stage-5D defect in which layout F4 resampled 24 draws where the frozen rule required its original 30

bootstrap.episode_universe: the manifest-enumerated SELECT-R source episodes, zero-yield included

winner: both eligible -> M2 iff upper95CI(d21) < 0, else M1 by parsimony

bootstrap_replicate_order: resample source episodes ONCE, paired across every seed and family
compute the event-equal NLL for each seed on that resample
that is the replicate's family statistic
family_statistic.definition: FamilyNLL(f) = ( NLL(f,11) + NLL(f,29) + NLL(f,47) ) / 3 on SELECT-R

generation_authority.operational_wrappers: may be newly written; each must be hashed and qualified before use and bound into the stage manifest
generation_authority.stochastic_law: the frozen iid disturbance law of the replica protocol; the clean-room roles differ only in generator offset and generation seed

generation_timing.MECH-R: only after the mechanism contract freeze
generation_timing.PROTECTED-R: only after the required upstream freezes and checkpoints
generation_timing.SELECT-R: after the model recipes are frozen and preferably after CR-2 training completes

interpretation_claim_mapping.if: SELECT-R supports M2 under the frozen rule
M2 does not win clean SELECT-R
the oracle does not help on CL-DEV-R
interpretation_claim_mapping.then: the recoverability-as-decision-variable premise is at risk; do not proceed automatically to MAIN-R

interpretation_claim_mapping.if: MAIN-R improves progress but safety fails
MAIN-R system benefit passes but the mechanism contrast fails
interpretation_claim_mapping.then: the system benefit may be claimed; the mechanism-specific claim may NOT

interpretation_claim_mapping.rule: no result may be rhetorically upgraded after reveal

forbidden_after_failure: inventing a new baseline from the results
main_r_failure_rule.on_failure: the frozen clean-room system failed confirmation

main_r_firewall.enforcement: the CR-9 generation driver refuses to run unless the CR-8 freeze root verifies and the MAIN-R role manifest does not yet exist; role manifests are enumerated, so an existing MAIN-R identity set is detectable and fails closed

mechanism_study.if_MAIN_R_passes_but_mechanism_fails: the system-level benefit may survive, but the recoverability-specific and graph-specific causal claims must be weakened

M0.closed_form: p_hat = (1 / 2E) * SUM over TRAIN events e and candidates c of k_{e,c} / R_{e,c}; this is the exact minimizer of the frozen event-equal grouped Bernoulli NLL for a constant predictor
M0.definition: q(o_i, tau) = p_hat for every robot and every candidate
M0.name: CONSTANT

M1.architecture: one hidden layer, width 32, ReLU, single logit output
M1.name: LOCAL_NON_GRAPH_MLP

M2.name: LOCAL_GRAPH_MODEL
M2.residual_action_head: present but EXCLUDED from the optimizer in this study

input_contract.R_reason: R is a deterministic function of family (F8/F9 -> 3, else 1) and family is not runtime-available, so admitting R would smuggle the family in
input_contract.mission_orientation_cos_sin: NOT admitted to the open-loop recoverability predictor. It may be used only by a residual head in a later study.
input_contract.name: MODEL_INPUT_CONTRACT_V3
structural_enforcement: the model's only entry point is prepare_fd24_model_batch(graphs: Sequence[RobotLocalEgoGraph]) -- a closed type
RobotView is a closed container; NeighbourRecord is ego-relative only
rvt_swarm/decentralized/guards.py AST guard over rvt_swarm.decentralized and rvt_swarm.fd24
tests: information boundary, permutation invariance, no global pooling, batch isolation

oracle_ceiling.definition: the learned predictor q_i(o_i, tau) is replaced by the simulator-computed recoverability probability p(x, tau) = P(Target-V4 = 1 | x, tau) under the frozen iid disturbance law, estimated by the frozen replica protocol from the TRUE full state. Every downstream stage -- counterfactual evaluation, selector, nominal control, safety projection -- is byte-identical to the learned system.

interpretation_rule.oracle_does_not_materially_improve_the_f: CORE_RECOVERABILITY_DECISION_PREMISE_AT_RISK; do not proceed automatically to MAIN-R
interpretation_rule.oracle_helps_but_learned_RVT_does_not: the predictor, ranking, selector or integration remains a development problem, not a refutation of the premise

oracle_ceiling.privileged_information: full state and forward rollouts, simulator-only
oracle_ceiling.purpose: test whether counterfactual recoverability information could in principle improve topology decisions

orchestration_authority.fixes: the pilot gap in which the Stage-5D orchestration script was bound by no hash and chose a family statistic the frozen rule did not define
orchestration_authority.orchestration_must: consume the executable manifest and call the qualified engine

pilot_boundary.pilot_may_inform: method design, architecture definitions, training recipe constants, and code that is re-qualified here
pilot_boundary.reason_preserved: Stage-5D executed a seed47-only family evaluation while the frozen family statistic required the mean over seeds {11,29,47} of the VALIDATION NLL

predictor_stop_rule.any_redesign_becomes: a NEW PILOT cycle requiring a future new clean-room programme
predictor_stop_rule.if_M2_wins: carry the newly trained M2 seed-47 checkpoint forward
predictor_stop_rule.if_SELECT_R_does_not_support_M2: STOP the M2-centric clean-room thesis programme

protected_generalization.F9_local_observability: preserved as a PREDECLARED analysis dimension. RobotView carries static obstacle tokens only and dynamic obstacles never enter the ego graph; this limitation is analysed, not repaired after results.

safety_contract.exact_effect_sizes_and_non_inferiority_m: resolved and frozen before CR-8, never after MAIN-R exists
safety_contract.interpretation_rule: progress or recovery improvement accompanied by unacceptable safety degradation DOES NOT support the central claim

training_recipe.checkpoint_rule: strict lower held-out TRAIN NLL; on exact tie the EARLIER step
training_recipe.fits_per_learned_family: 3 seeds x 2 folds for step determination, then 3 refits
training_recipe.hyperparameter_search_on_TRAIN_R: NONE -- the configuration is frozen here as a constant, informed by pilot development. This removes the pilot's 72-fit search and every TRAIN-R-outcome-dependent hyperparameter decision.

refit_step_rule.inputs: s_A and s_B, the selected scheduled steps for (c*, seed) on folds A and B; each is a multiple of 1000
refit_step_rule.why_ceil: the mean of two multiples of 1000 can land on a half-multiple; ceiling to the next 1000 is unambiguous and needs no half-rounding convention
refit_step_rule.why_not_rescaled: optimizer STEPS, not epochs, are the frozen budget unit; the refit therefore takes the same number of gradient updates while drawing from a 2x larger pool, which is the conservative choice

shared.initialization: framework default under torch.manual_seed(seed) plus a per-fit generator; no custom initialization scheme
shared.tie_rule: on machine-visible equality choose the EARLIER checkpoint

weighting.replica_supervision: divided by R through the frozen grouped Bernoulli NLL
weighting.short_final_batch: averaged over its own event count, so every event stays equally weighted within its step

training_recipe.stopping_rule: early stopping on the held-out TRAIN-R internal fold only; VALIDATION-class data is never used for stopping

train_internal_folds.balance: each fold contains exactly one layout per family f1-f10
train_internal_folds.membership_authority: the frozen clean-room TRAIN-R registry, never the layout-id string
